steps.instruction:
Introduce yourself with this line
Hey it is Mauricio your favorite robot boy what are we doing today
steps.completion: The introduction and invitation finished playing.

steps.instruction: Look around for an objective using brief pivots and fresh observations. Identify something visible and achievable to investigate or find a person to ask for a mission. Explain the proposed objective or ask what to do and listen. Only approach along a visually assessed clear route. If no useful objective or assessable route is apparent stay stopped and ask the user for a task.
steps.completion: A meaningful next objective has been identified and communicated or supplied by the user.
